title: Metallbau announces +2.1 % on Motor bracket HB
briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Metallbau Steinfelder KG. Metallbau announces +2.1 % on Motor bracket HB. Need: 7830 pc a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 22 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.
